## What and why
What this changes, and the issue it belongs to: #

Code changes target `staging`; documentation targets `main` (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or reading
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or performance

## What I tested, and on what
- [ ] A car
- [ ] An adapter on the bench
- [ ] An emulator
- [ ] Unit tests only (`./gradlew test`; for Sapphire `npm test`)

Say plainly what was not tested. "Not tested on a car" is a fine answer.

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests for the change (for a bug: a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] A changelog entry (`android/CHANGELOG.md` or `web/CHANGELOG.md`) in the format used there
- [ ] If an LLM helped write this, I have said so here
